tier2_explanatory.long_meaning: From the Hebrew Yirmeyahu, from a root meaning 'to exalt', + Yahu, 'Yahweh'. Its root is Hebrew r-w-m-y-h-w. The prophet Jeremiah; the Book of Jeremiah. Jeremiah is a Hebrew name meaning “Yahweh exalts”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
